name: Display: composer + buffer allocator (DRM or fbdev)
description: Replaces Huawei's display HALs with either a DRM/KMS composer (atomic commits, real vblank, DPMS + backlight) or, when the kernel has no DRM, an msm fbdev composer (MSMFB_ATOMIC_COMMIT on one fullscreen client layer, software 60 Hz vsync, wled backlight). Buffers are allocated as DRM dumb+PRIME objects or from the msm ION system heap. Without it there is no picture.
